short_summary: A slide deck introducing HealthRate, a data‑driven AI‑enabled contract arbitrage platform, and presenting its leadership and advisory team.
long_summary: The document is a PowerPoint slide deck titled HealthRate Team_12.16.25. It presents HealthRate as a data‑driven, AI‑enabled contract arbitrage platform. The deck lists the leadership team: Tim Michaels (Chief Executive Officer), Tom Sherrard (EVP, Sales & Market Development), and Jeff Sage (Chief Product Officer), providing phone numbers and email addresses for each. It also introduces the advisory board members—Bob Van Why, Geoff Bartsh, Paul Stordahl, and Mark Nathan—without contact details. The slides are marked as proprietary and confidential.
